title: Prompt Contract Schema
description: JSON Schema for validating prompt contracts. Prompts are templates used by agents and the Planner. They declare variables, output format, and compatibility.

description.description: Human-readable description used for semantic retrieval embedding

intent_match.description: Intents that trigger this prompt (used for retrieval matching)

variables.description: Template variables that must be filled before use

template_file.description: Path to the prompt template file (e.g. k1/prompts/agents/invitation_drafter_v1.txt)

max_tokens.description: Recommended token budget for this prompt

output_format.description: Expected output format from the prompt

compatible_agents.description: Agent capability names that can use this prompt

compatible_tools.description: Tool capability names compatible with this prompt

requires_human_confirmation.description: Explicit override for HIL gating. true -> always ask user; false -> never ask. Omit / null -> infer (prompts have no safety_band, so default is no HIL).

side_effects.description: Structured declaration of side effects (rare for prompts; reserved for future prompt-driven side-effecting templates). NOTE: this schema does NOT enforce the cross-field invariant that any side_effect with kind in {data_delete, data_modify, payment, physical_actuation, irreversible_op, third_party_share} should imply requires_human_confirmation=true. The HIL gate (k1/fabric/_run_hil_gate) and the unified HumanInTheLoopService apply that policy at runtime via CapabilityContractView.requires_human_confirmation. An allOf guard could be added here for static validation, but is intentionally omitted to keep the schema permissive while runtime policy remains authoritative.

reversible.description: Whether this side effect can be undone after execution

name.description: Variable name as used in the template

required.description: Whether this variable must be provided

default.description: Default value if not provided (only valid when required=false)

description.description: Human-readable description of what this variable is for
